description: City of Port Phillip Drinking Fountains is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by City of Port Phillip. Water drinking fountains managed by City of Port Phillip. Dataset contains: Spatial Location and the Council's asset Identification number. This does not include water drinking fountains located on Parks Victoria or managed on private property. Coverage: City of Port Phillip. The portal files it under the publisher City of Port Phillip. Its tags are Environment, Water drinking taps, drinking fountains. It offers 1 resource(s) in geojson. The portal shows 2022-08-11 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution 2.5 Australia. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
